author: gpt-5.6-luna
brief: Phase: bug fix. Role: developer. Repo kind: a Node.js 24 internal HTTP client wrapper (no dependencies; a request function over node:http with timeouts, retries, a small response cache, logging, tests that use a local test server, CI config, docs). About 30 files. Inspiration (a bug class only, nothing copied): public HTTP clients have fixed defects where Retry-After is read in the wrong unit or ignored, retries are counted twice, a request body is consumed by the first attempt, or a timeout fires after the response. Build a task where the owner reports symptoms (retries hammer a server that asked for a pause, POST retries send empty bodies, calls hang for minutes), with no diagnosis. Two or three interacting defects, one subtle. Visible tests pass today and do not point at them.
